summary: First-iteration testing of Aura Commerce (Expo + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass covering health, JWT auth (register/login/me/logout), catalog (categories/banners/products list+detail+filter+search), cart (add/update/clear/hydrated totals), wishlist toggle, addresses CRUD, coupons list + WELCOME10/SAVE200/AURA25 apply + min-order guard, checkout (order creation, stock impact, notification), orders list/detail/cancel, reviews adding + product rating recompute, notifications list + read-all, admin stats + role guard + status advance (packed→shipped→out_for_delivery→delivered). Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 – Login screen renders with prefilled demo creds, Sign In succeeds, /home shows header/search/banner carousel/categories/flash sale/featured grid, category tap navigates to /category/cat_electronics, product card tap navigates to PDP with gallery/variants (Color: Onyx/Sand/Terracotta)/price/rating/Add to Cart, /cart lists item with qty controls & totals (subtotal ₹4,499 + tax ₹224.95 = ₹4,723.95, free shipping), Proceed to Checkout navigates to /checkout with address form + delivery slot + payment (COD/mock_card) + coupon input + Place order. Profile page correctly does NOT show Admin row for demo customer (role guard OK).

minor.issue: Adding a review recomputes product.rating and product.review_count from the reviews collection only, ignoring the seeded review_count/rating baked into DEMO_PRODUCTS. First real review therefore drops review_count from e.g. 218 → 1. Acceptable for MVP but note that seeded review_count is effectively lost the moment any customer reviews a product.
Email is silently lowercased server-side but the response echoes the normalized value. Fine, but frontend/test callers should compare case-insensitively.

integration_issues.flow: Checkout place-order for a brand-new account without any saved address
integration_issues.issue: The Place-order button remains visible but is disabled/opaque until an address is saved. There is no inline error banner explaining WHY it is disabled, which can confuse first-time users. Consider auto-scrolling to the address section or showing 'Add a delivery address to continue'.

issues: Demo credentials hint block uses low-contrast onBrandSecondary text on brandSecondary background – verify WCAG AA. Otherwise polished.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings surfaced on every screen load: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from src/ui or src/theme shadow tokens and a Pressable/View using the prop form. Reference: repeated console.warn from RN-Web on /login and /home.

action_items: Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow (or gate them for web) and move pointerEvents from prop to style prop across theme/shadow helpers and any Pressable using pointerEvents={...}.
Consider preserving seeded review_count as a floor (e.g. Math.max(len(reviews), seeded_count)) or seed real review docs so DEMO_PRODUCTS review counts do not drop after the first customer review.
On /checkout, disable/hide Place-order until address is chosen AND show a helper text 'Add a delivery address' so users understand why the primary CTA is inactive.
Add an integration test for admin login → /admin dashboard KPIs and the 'Advance' button (only backend admin flow was covered here).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown') hooks – migrate to lifespan handlers for FastAPI >=0.109.

backend/server.py currently allows any authenticated user to POST /api/reviews for any product without proving the user has purchased the product (no order/purchase check). Fine for MVP demo but worth flagging.
backend/server.py: /api/checkout does not currently validate stock >= quantity before creating the order (only decrements via $inc). Stock can go negative under contention.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (via src/api.ts) which resolves correctly to the ingress host – good, no hardcoded URLs seen.
Interactive elements (login, product card, cart controls, checkout, tab bar) all expose testID – excellent for automated testing.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all navigation + rendering + interaction verified; full end-to-end order placement in UI not confirmed for the demo user without a pre-saved address, but underlying API works)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Demo customer (demo@aura.com/Demo@123) and admin (admin@aura.com/Admin@123) are auto-seeded by the backend startup event. Tests create TEST_-prefixed user, address, and reviews which the fixtures clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green – run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py first (pytest -v). Frontend uses Expo Router; direct URL navigation works (e.g. /cart, /checkout, /profile). All key testIDs discovered: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, home-search-bar, category-<id>, product-card-<id>, banner-<id>, cart-item-<pid>, qty-inc-<pid>, qty-dec-<pid>, qty-del-<pid>, checkout-cta, checkout-back, addr-full_name/phone/line1/line2/city/state/pincode, save-address, slot-<label>, payment-cod, payment-mock_card, coupon-input, apply-coupon, place-order, profile-wishlist/addresses/offers/notifications, logout-btn. Admin dashboard UI and Advance button flow were not verified in-browser this iteration – recommend an admin-login playwright pass next.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no blocking bugs. Two pytest failures during the first run were test-side assertion issues (email case-sensitivity and stale seed review_count expectation) and were corrected in the test file; backend behaviour is by design.
